disease_label_per_paper: Periprosthetic joint infection of the left knee (revision total knee arthroplasty) caused by Haemophilus parainfluenzae (paper Case #1 of two)
case_selection_note: The paper reports two patients; only Case #1 (54-year-old man) is structured here.
presentation_summary: 54-year-old man with multiple prior left knee surgeries, most recently a revision left total knee arthroplasty 2 years earlier, presented with 4 days of left knee pain, swelling, and warmth.
He was afebrile. Knee aspiration on admission: WBC 107,500 cells/uL, 87% PMNs, RBC 16,000 cells/uL, leukocyte esterase 3+. Serum ESR 25 mm/h, CRP 143.7 mg/L.
time_zero_definition: Admission (knee aspiration and first serum inflammatory markers); symptom onset 4 days earlier.

quality_warnings: Paper reports two patients; only Case #1 is used.
No numeric vital signs reported (only 'afebrile'); no serum CBC reported.
Synovial fluid cell count and leukocyte esterase are presentation aspiration labs (rankable); intraoperative culture species and blood cultures are non-ranking.
The prosthesis is encoded as observed context axes; the surgical history in risk_context is record-only to avoid double counting.
